2026-10-07TCFinancial Administration ActAppointment of a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc.Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Lynn Healey of St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador, to be a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of four years, in the place of Craig Priddle, whose term has expired.N/A
subject: Appointment of a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc.
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Lynn Healey of St. John’s, Newfoundland and Labrador, to be a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of four years, in the place of Craig Priddle, whose term has expired.
